app.name: Stockroom
app.description: A focused inventory system for clothing brands.

auth.title: Welcome back
auth.subtitle: Log in to manage your inventory.
auth.needAccess: Need access? Ask an administrator to provision your account via the {command} command.

index.title: Stock
index.description: Live on-hand quantities by variant and location.
index.empty: No stock matches the current filters.
index.wildcardPoolTooltip: Inherits {pool} unit(s) from a wildcard at this location — effective total {total} on Shopify.

adjust.title: Adjust stock
adjust.description: Drill from coarse to fine to pinpoint the exact variant, then set the on-hand quantity.
adjust.pickToContinue: Pick a location and product on the left to continue.
adjust.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. cycle count adjustment, damaged units, intake from supplier…
adjust.noVariantsForSelection: No variants match the current selection.

convert.title: Convert wildcard
convert.description: Take stock from a wildcard (printless base) and turn it into a printed product. Both sides of the swap happen at the same location, in one transaction.
convert.wildcardHint: Only wildcard products are listed here — those marked 🃏 in the catalog.
convert.pickToContinue: Pick a wildcard variant and location on the left to continue.
convert.wildcardOnHand: Wildcard on hand at this location
convert.noTargets: No printed products derive from this wildcard variant (or none with a matching color/size).
convert.outOfStock: No wildcard stock at this location

movements.title: Stock movements
movements.description: Append-only history of every stock change.
movements.emptyForProduct: No movements yet for this product.

index.title: Products
index.description: The catalog of items you sell.

create.title: New product
create.description: Define a product and the variant combinations it ships in.
create.variantsHint: Pick the attribute values you carry. We'll generate one SKU per combination ({count} variant | {count} variants total).

edit.title: Edit {name}
edit.description: Add new attribute combinations to introduce more variants. Existing variants and stock are untouched.
edit.variantsHint: Selecting additional values creates new variant combinations. Removing a value here does not remove the variant — it stays so its history is preserved.

wildcard.label: Wildcard product
wildcard.sectionDescription: A wildcard product is a printless base (e.g. a blank hoodie) whose stock acts as a shared pool for the printed products derived from it. On Shopify the wildcard's stock is folded into each printed product's quantity.
wildcard.sectionDescriptionShort: Pick how this product relates to wildcards. A wildcard's stock is pooled into the Shopify quantity of every printed product derived from it.

modes.standaloneHelp: Its own stock only — no shared pool.
modes.derivesHelp: Inherits a wildcard's stock for matching color/size when syncing to Shopify.
modes.wildcardHelp: Stock acts as a shared pool for other products in this category. Not pushed to Shopify on its own.

wildcard.isWildcardHelp: Wildcards aren't pushed to Shopify on their own. Other products in the same category can pick this one as their source.
wildcard.lockedOff: Locked: {count} product(s) currently derive from this wildcard. Remove the source on those products first to change this.
wildcard.noSource: None — this product has its own stock only
wildcard.noOptionsForCategory: No wildcard products in this category yet.

banner.wildcardBody: This product's stock acts as a shared pool. When the printed products derived from it are pushed to Shopify, the wildcard's matching color/size stock is added to each printed quantity.
banner.derivedBody: This product's effective Shopify quantity includes the {source} wildcard's stock for matching color/size.

wildcard.derivativesHeader: Printed products derived from this wildcard

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Each category declares which attributes its products use.
categories.attributesUsed: Attributes used by products in this category

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Physical places where stock is held.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Reusable color attribute applied to product variants.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Reusable size attribute applied to product variants.

variantSelector.noProducts: No products in this category yet.

sync.title: Shopify sync
sync.description: Pair local variants with Shopify and reconcile inventory in both directions.

notConfigured.title: Shopify isn't configured
notConfigured.body: Create an app in dev.shopify.com, install it on your store via Distribution → Custom distribution, then set SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN, SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID, and SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET in your .env. We exchange the client credentials for a 24h Admin API token at runtime.

link.empty: Nothing to do — no local variants.
link.emptyNoLocal: Your local catalog is empty — create products first via /products/create, or run node ace db:seed. Shopify variants are listed but there's nothing local to pair them with yet.
link.intro: Each local variant can mirror multiple Shopify variants (useful when Shopify has duplicate products with different photography). Add pairings; we match at runtime by Shopify variant ID.
link.modalTitle: Pick Shopify variant(s) to link to {name}
link.modalSearch: Filter by product or variant title…

push.empty: Nothing to push — local and Shopify totals match for every linked variant.
push.intro: Local totals that don't match one or more Shopify mirrors. Tick rows to write the local number to all mirrors of that variant.

pull.empty: Nothing to pull — Shopify mirrors are all at their last-known quantity.
pull.intro: Shopify-side decreases (typically online orders) across one or more mirrors of each variant. Per-row, pick which local location absorbs the total decrement.
pull.autoPushNote: After applying, all mirrors of each variant will be re-pushed to the new local total.

filters.noMatches: No rows match the current filters.

sync.wildcardPoolHint: {own} own + {pool} from a wildcard of matching color/size = {total} effective on Shopify.
